audit.definition: Climactic Mazama bulk airborne fallout, including co-ignimbrite ash. Both endpoints of an eligible complete-bed range enter as one interval event. Primary-coded Buckland observations with a local quantity enter by default, subject to documented site exceptions.

validation.interpretation: Full matched training-fold posterior, fixed bearing prior and training-only support. Scores include exact readings and limit events.

source_checks.normalization: Analytical circular kernels; component centres can move away from the vent.

reproducibility.normalization: Finite-Earth component normalization followed by positive quadrature of retained mass under each normalized parent mixture.

bearing.posterior_interpretation: Parent amplitude and kernel parameters follow the original posterior. The principal mass is its integrated retained fraction times parent volume. A single latent orientation applies to a complete deposit.
bearing.numerical_interpretation: NUTS diagnostics and attempt histories describe parent draws. Each fit separately records spatial integration and split-draw checks on derived volume.

parent_reference_km3.interpretation: 95% equal-tailed Bayesian credible interval conditional on this likelihood, prior and field family. Includes parameter and fan uncertainty; excludes unknown systematic preservation, sampling and source-attribution bias. Not dense-rock equivalent or ignimbrite volume.
